results.question: What hardware did I train the Pac-Man agent and the nanoGPT models on?
results.answer: The Pac-Man agent was trained on a Cloud Linux VM with 2 CPU cores and no GPU, using PyTorch on CPU [S3]. The nanoGPT models were trained on a Cloud Linux container with x86-64 architecture, 2 CPU cores, and no GPU, using Python 3.11.15 and PyTorch 2.14.0 [S8].
